verses.sloka: गतेष्वथ नृपो भूयः पौरेषु सह मन्त्रिभिः ।मन्त्रयुत्वा ततश्चक्रे निश्चयज्ञः स निश्चयम् ॥२-४-१॥
verses.transliteration: gateṣvatha nṛpo bhūyaḥ paureṣu saha mantribhiḥ ।mantrayutvā tataścakre niścayajñaḥ sa niścayam ॥2-4-1॥

translations.english: After the citizens departed, the king, an expert in decisionmaking again consulted his counsellors and said, Tomorrow Pushya star is in the ascendence and my son, Rama (handsome) with coppercoloured eyes which resemble red lotus petals will be installed heirapparent.
translations.hindi: रानी केकेयी की जाति की एक दासी थी जो उसके साथ उसके मायके से आई थी और सदा उसके साथ रहती थी। उसका नाम मन्थरा था, उस रात को, जिस दिन दरबार में श्रीराम- चन्द्र जी फे युवराजपद पर प्रतिष्ठित करने की घोषणा महाराज दशरथ ने की थी, वह अकस्मात्‌ चन्द्रमा के समान सफेद अटारी की छत पर चढ़ी

verses.sloka: श्व एव पुष्यो भविता श्वोऽभिषेच्यस्तु मे सुतः ।रामो राजीवताम्राक्षो यौवराज्य इति प्रभुः ॥२-४-२॥
verses.transliteration: śva eva puṣyo bhavitā śvo'bhiṣecyastu me sutaḥ ।rāmo rājīvatāmrākṣo yauvarājya iti prabhuḥ ॥2-4-2॥

translations.english: After the citizens departed, the king, an expert in decisionmaking again consulted his counsellors and said, Tomorrow Pushya star is in the ascendence and my son, Rama (handsome) with coppercoloured eyes which resemble red lotus petals will be installed heirapparent.
translations.hindi: नेता है, उसी प्रकार हर से आए हुए ओर कं de 2 Fb ce Ft ४... उस दिन अमरावती के समान अयोध्यापुरी को देखने के है | लिए जो लोग बाहर से आए हुए थे, उन लोगों से उ के | * > ॒ स पुरी की | .. शोभा बैसी ही हो गई जैसी शोभा समुद्र की जल जन्तु (मत्स्य, | . कच्छ, नक ) से होती है

verses.sloka: अथान्तर्गृहमासाद्य राजा दशरथस्तदा ।सूतमामन्त्रयामास रामं पुनरिहानय ॥२-४-३॥
verses.transliteration: athāntargṛhamāsādya rājā daśarathastadā ।sūtamāmantrayāmāsa rāmaṁ punarihānaya ॥2-4-3॥

translations.english: Therafter king Dasaratha on retiring to his private apartment, ordered Sumantra to bring Rama once again.
translations.hindi: ज्ञातदासी--कैकेय्याः जञातीनां बन्धूनां दासी || (वि० ) २ यतो- जाता - यत्रकुत्रचित्‌ जाता | ( वि० ) | ' वा० रा० हणा > ६६ अयोध्याकाण्डे ऊचे मकानों पर बहुमूल्य ध्त्रजा-पताकाएँ फइरा रही हैं। सड़कों के गडढे आदि पाट कर वे चौरस कर दी गई हैं, लोगे के आने-जाने में भीडभाड न हो, अतः बड़े चौडे-चौडे रास्ते बनाए गए हैँ, जो सिर से स्नान किए हुए ( अथीत्‌ तेल, उपटन लगा कर स्नान किए हुए ) दशकों से भरे हुए हैं

verses.sloka: प्रतिगृह्य स तद्वाक्यं सूतः पुनरुपाययौ ।रामस्य भवनं शीघ्रं राममानयितुं पुनः ॥२-४-४॥
verses.transliteration: pratigṛhya sa tadvākyaṁ sūtaḥ punarupāyayau ।rāmasya bhavanaṁ śīghraṁ rāmamānayituṁ punaḥ ॥2-4-4॥

translations.english: In obedience to the command of the king charioteer Sumantra set out speedily to the palace of Rama to fetch him back once again.
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्र जो को भट में देने के लिए माला, लडडू ( आदि शुभ वस्तुएँ ) लिए श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मण घूम रहे हें । देवमन्दिरो के द्वार कलई आदि से ) सफेद पोते गए हें; जहाँ देखो वहाँ बाजे बाज रहे हैं

verses.sloka: द्वाःस्थैरावेदितं तस्य रामायागमनं पुनः ।श्रुत्वैव चापि रामस्तं प्राप्तं शङ्कान्वितोऽभवत् ॥२-४-५॥
verses.transliteration: dvāḥsthairāveditaṁ tasya rāmāyāgamanaṁ punaḥ ।śrutvaiva cāpi rāmastaṁ prāptaṁ śaṅkānvito'bhavat ॥2-4-5॥

translations.english: The doorkeepers informed Rama of Sumantra's arrival. As soon as he learnt that Sumantra was back again, Rama was filled with apprehensions.

verses.sloka: प्रवेश्य चैनं त्वरितं रामो वचन मब्रवीत् ।यदागमनकृत्यं ते भूयस्तद्भ्रुह्यशेषतः ॥२-४-६॥
verses.transliteration: praveśya cainaṁ tvaritaṁ rāmo vacana mabravīt ।yadāgamanakṛtyaṁ te bhūyastadbhruhyaśeṣataḥ ॥2-4-6॥

translations.english: Rama got Sumantra admitted and said to him, What is the purpose of your coming back so quickly ? Tell me whatever is there without holding back.
translations.hindi: सब लोग उत्सव में मत्त हैं, चारों ओर बेदध्वनि हो रही है । मनुष्यों का.तो कहना ही क्या, हाथी, घोडे, गो, बैल तक आनन्द में भर हषेध्वनि कर रहे है ।५)। प्रहृष्टमुदितै। पोरेरुच्छितध्वजमालिनीम्‌ ।- अयोध्यां मन्थरा इष्टवा पर॑ विस्मंयमागता

verses.sloka: तमुवाच ततः सूतो राजा त्वां द्रष्टु मिच्छति ।श्रुत्वा प्रमाणमत्र त्वं गमनायेतराय वा ॥२-४-७॥
verses.transliteration: tamuvāca tataḥ sūto rājā tvāṁ draṣṭu micchati ।śrutvā pramāṇamatra tvaṁ gamanāyetarāya vā ॥2-4-7॥

translations.english: Then Sumantra replied, 'The king desires to see you. To go or not to go, the decision is yours'.
translations.hindi: अति हृषित और सफेद रेशमी साड़ी पहिने हुए श्रीरामचन्द्र की धात्री (उपमाता) से, जो पास ही खड़ी थी, मन्थरा पूछने लगी

verses.sloka: इति सूतवचः श्रुत्वा रामोऽथ त्वरयान्वितः ।प्रययौ राजभवनं पुनर्द्रष्टुं नरेश्वरम् ॥२-४-८॥
verses.transliteration: iti sūtavacaḥ śrutvā rāmo'tha tvarayānvitaḥ ।prayayau rājabhavanaṁ punardraṣṭuṁ nareśvaram ॥2-4-8॥

translations.english: On hearing the words of the charioteer, Rama immediately set out for the royal palace to see the king again.
translations.hindi: आज हषे में भरी मालदार सती राममाता कौसल्या लोगों को थन क्यों बॉट रही है

verses.sloka: तं श्रुत्वा समनुप्राप्तं रामं दशरथो नृपः ।प्रवेश्यामास गृहं विवक्षुः प्रियमुत्तमम् ॥२-४-९॥
verses.transliteration: taṁ śrutvā samanuprāptaṁ rāmaṁ daśaratho nṛpaḥ ।praveśyāmāsa gṛhaṁ vivakṣuḥ priyamuttamam ॥2-4-9॥

translations.english: Having heard of Rama's arrival, king Dasaratha got him admitted into his apartment to tell him something very pleasant.

verses.sloka: प्रविश्न्नेप च श्रीमान् राघवो भवनं पितुः ।ददर्श पितरं दूरात् प्रणिपत्य कृताञ्ज्लिः ॥२-४-१०॥
verses.transliteration: praviśnnepa ca śrīmān rāghavo bhavanaṁ pituḥ ।dadarśa pitaraṁ dūrāt praṇipatya kṛtāñjliḥ ॥2-4-10॥

translations.english: On entering his father's palace, glorious Rama, folded his hands and bent low in reverence from a distance and beheld his father.
translations.hindi: मन्थरा के इस प्रकार पूछने पर वह धात्री जो मारे आनन्द ` के फूल करु कुप्प हो रही थी, श्रीरामचन्द्र को महतो राज्यश्री- लाभ का समाचार कुत्रड़ी मन्थरा से कहने लगी

verses.sloka: प्रणमन्तं समुत्थाप्य तं परिष्वज्य भूमिपः ।प्रदिश्य चास्मै रुचिरमासनं पुनरब्रवीत् ॥२-४-११॥
verses.transliteration: praṇamantaṁ samutthāpya taṁ pariṣvajya bhūmipaḥ ।pradiśya cāsmai ruciramāsanaṁ punarabravīt ॥2-4-11॥

translations.english: As he (Rama) was bending (with reverence), Dasaratha lifted him up and embraced him. Thereafter, he offered him a splendid seat and said again:
translations.hindi: उसने कहा कल प्रांतःकाल होते ही पुष्य नक्षत्र में जितक्रोध ` एवं पुण्यात्मा श्रीरामचन्द्र जी को महाराज दशरथ युवराजपद्‌ पर स्थापित करगे

verses.sloka: राम वृद्धोऽस्मि दीर्घायुर्भुक्ता भोगा मयेप्सिताः ।अन्न्वद्भिः क्रतुश्तैस्तथेष्टं भूरिदक्षिणैः ॥२-४-१२॥
verses.transliteration: rāma vṛddho'smi dīrghāyurbhuktā bhogā mayepsitāḥ ।annvadbhiḥ kratuśtaistatheṣṭaṁ bhūridakṣiṇaiḥ ॥2-4-12॥

translations.english: O Rama after a long life I have grown old. I have enjoyed all the pleasures I desired. I have also performed hundreds of rituals which enjoined distribution of abundant food and gifts.

verses.sloka: जातमिष्टमपत्यं मे त्वमद्यानुपमं भुवि ।दत्तमिष्टमधीतं च मया पुरुषसत्तम ॥२-४-१३॥
verses.transliteration: jātamiṣṭamapatyaṁ me tvamadyānupamaṁ bhuvi ।dattamiṣṭamadhītaṁ ca mayā puruṣasattama ॥2-4-13॥

translations.english: O best of men I have obtained now a progeny of my liking in you and you have no equal on earth. I have given gifts, performed rituals and also studied (the Vedas) .
translations.hindi: चह पापिन क्रोध में जली-भुनी ( शयनागार में जा कर) सोती | हुई कैकेयी (को जगा कर उस) से बोली

verses.sloka: अनुभूतानि चेष्टानि मया वीर सुखान्यपि ।देवर्षिपितृविप्राणामनृणोऽस्मि तथात्मनः ॥२-४-१४॥
verses.transliteration: anubhūtāni ceṣṭāni mayā vīra sukhānyapi ।devarṣipitṛviprāṇāmanṛṇo'smi tathātmanaḥ ॥2-4-14॥

translations.english: O mighty son I have experienced all the pleasures I longed for. I redeemed my debt to the gods, the sages, my ancestors, brahmins and to myself.

verses.sloka: न किञ्चिन्म कर्तव्यं तवान्यत्राभिषेचनात् ।अतो युत्त्वामहं ब्रूयां तन्मे त्वं कर्तुमर्हसि ॥२-४-१५॥
verses.transliteration: na kiñcinma kartavyaṁ tavānyatrābhiṣecanāt ।ato yuttvāmahaṁ brūyāṁ tanme tvaṁ kartumarhasi ॥2-4-15॥

translations.english: There is nothing left to be done by me except your consecration Hence you should perform what I tell you.

verses.sloka: अद्य प्रकृतयः सर्वास्त्वामिच्छन्ति नराधिपम् ।अतस्त्वां युवराजानमभिषेक्ष्यामि पुत्रक ॥२-४-१६॥
verses.transliteration: adya prakṛtayaḥ sarvāstvāmicchanti narādhipam ।atastvāṁ yuvarājānamabhiṣekṣyāmi putraka ॥2-4-16॥

translations.english: Today all the subjects expresed their desire to see you as their king. Therefore, my dear son, I wish to coronate you heirapparent.
translations.hindi: पापिन कुञ्जा के क्रोध से भरे ऐसे रूखे बचन सुन कैकेयी को बड़ा दुःख हुआ

verses.sloka: अपि चाद्याशुभान् राम स्वप्ने प्श्यामि दारुणान् ।सनिर्घाता दिवोल्का च परतीह महास्वना ॥२-४-१७॥
verses.transliteration: api cādyāśubhān rāma svapne pśyāmi dāruṇān ।sanirghātā divolkā ca paratīha mahāsvanā ॥2-4-17॥

translations.english: Moreover Rama, these days I see frightening and ominous events in dreams during day time. I see meteors accompanied by thunders falling, generating great sounds.
translations.hindi: केकेयी ने उससे कहा--हे मन्थरे ! बतला कुशल तो है ? तूने क्यों अपना चेहरा इतना उदास कर रखा है ओर तू क्यों इतनी दुखी हो रही है ९

verses.sloka: अवष्टब्धं च मे राम नक्षत्रं दारुणैर्ग्रहैः ।आवेदयन्ति दैवज्ञावः सूर्याङ्गारकराहुभिः ॥२-४-१८॥
verses.transliteration: avaṣṭabdhaṁ ca me rāma nakṣatraṁ dāruṇairgrahaiḥ ।āvedayanti daivajñāvaḥ sūryāṅgārakarāhubhiḥ ॥2-4-18॥

translations.english: O Rama astrologers also tell me that formidable planets Sun, Mars and Rahu have afflicted my birth star.
translations.hindi: कैकेयी के ऐसे सहालुभूतिपूणे बचन सुन, बात बनाने में निपुण मन्थरा ने बिगड़ कर कहा

verses.sloka: प्रायेण हि निमित्तानामीदृशानां समुद्भवे ।राजा हि मृत्युमाप्नोति घोरं वापदमृच्छति ॥२-४-१९॥
verses.transliteration: prāyeṇa hi nimittānāmīdṛśānāṁ samudbhave ।rājā hi mṛtyumāpnoti ghoraṁ vāpadamṛcchati ॥2-4-19॥

translations.english: When such ominous signs appear, usually the king either meets with death or faces a grave calamity.

verses.sloka: तद्यावदेव मे चेतो न विमुञ्चति राघव ।तावदेवाभिषिञ्चस्व चला हि प्राणिनां मतिः ॥२-४-२०॥
verses.transliteration: tadyāvadeva me ceto na vimuñcati rāghava ।tāvadevābhiṣiñcasva calā hi prāṇināṁ matiḥ ॥2-4-20॥

translations.english: Therefore, before my mind is deluded I wish to see you installed as heirapparent for a man's mind is unstable indeed, O Rama.
translations.hindi: उसने अपना चेहरा बड़ा ही उदास बना कर और अपने को कैकेयी की परमहितेषिणी जनाते हुए तथा श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के विषय में भेदबुद्धि उत्पन्न कर, झगडा कराने को कहा ॥ १६] अक्षय्यं सुमहद वि भ्रदृत्तं त्वद्विनांज्ञनम्‌। > * 9 AN _ द्‌ रामं दशरथो राजा योवराज्येऽभिषेक्ष्यति

verses.sloka: अद्य चन्द्रोभ्युपगतः पुष्यात्पूर्वं पुनर्वसू ।श्वः पुष्ययोगं नियतं वक्ष्यन्ते दैवचिन्तकाः ॥२-४-२१॥
verses.transliteration: adya candrobhyupagataḥ puṣyātpūrvaṁ punarvasū ।śvaḥ puṣyayogaṁ niyataṁ vakṣyante daivacintakāḥ ॥2-4-21॥

translations.english: Today the Moon is in conjunction with the Punarvasu constellation. Tomorrow the Moon's conjunction with the Pushya constellation is certain and the astrologers say this auspicious time is highly suitable for the purpose of coronation.
translations.hindi: सो मैं अथाह भय में डूबी और दु:ख एबं शोक से पूण मानो आग से जलाई हुई, तेरे हित के लिए यहाँ आई हूँ

verses.sloka: ततः पुष्येऽभिषिञ्चस्व मनस्त्वरयतीव माम् ।श्वस्त्वाहमभिषेक्ष्यामि यौवराज्ये परंतप ॥२-४-२२॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ puṣye'bhiṣiñcasva manastvarayatīva mām ।śvastvāhamabhiṣekṣyāmi yauvarājye paraṁtapa ॥2-4-22॥

translations.english: ﻿﻿ My mind is hastening me saying, 'Coronate Rama in the Pushya constellation itself'. O Slayer of enemies, I shall install you heir apparent tomorrow.

verses.sloka: तस्मात्त्वयादप्रभृति निशेयं नियतात्मना ।सह वध्वोपवस्तव्या दर्भप्रस्तरशायिना ॥२-४-२३॥
verses.transliteration: tasmāttvayādaprabhṛti niśeyaṁ niyatātmanā ।saha vadhvopavastavyā darbhaprastaraśāyinā ॥2-4-23॥

translations.english: Therefore, you and my daughterinlaw (Sita) should fast tonight and sleep on a bed of darbha or kusha grass with selfrestraint.
translations.hindi: नराधिपकुले जाता महिषी त्वं महीपतेः । ` उग्रत्वं राजधमाणां कथं देवि न बुध्यसे

verses.sloka: सुहृदश्चाप्रमत्तास्त्वां रक्षन्त्वद्य समन्ततः ।भवन्ति बहुविघ्नानि कार्याण्येवंविधानि हि ॥२-४-२४॥
verses.transliteration: suhṛdaścāpramattāstvāṁ rakṣantvadya samantataḥ ।bhavanti bahuvighnāni kāryāṇyevaṁvidhāni hi ॥2-4-24॥

translations.english: Many impediments befall acts of this sort indeed. Alert your friends to protect you from all sides today onwards.
translations.hindi: तेरा पति. दिखाने को तो बड़ा सत्यवादी बना हुआ है, किन्तु भीतर से महदा धूते है। बह बोलता मधुर दै, किन्तु मन. उसका ` ge $. बड़ा कठोर है । तू मन की साफ है-इसीसे तेरे ऊपर यह विपत्ति आई है

verses.sloka: विप्रोषितश्च भरतो यावदेव पुरादितः ।तावदेवाभिषेकस्ते प्राप्तकालो मतो मम ॥२-४-२५॥
verses.transliteration: viproṣitaśca bharato yāvadeva purāditaḥ ।tāvadevābhiṣekaste prāptakālo mato mama ॥2-4-25॥

translations.english: While Bharata is away from the city, the time is favourable for your installation. This is my opinion.
translations.hindi: हे कैकेयी ! तेरे दुःख से तो मैं दुःखी होती हूँ और तेरे सुख से में सुखी होती हूँ । इसमें कुछ भी सन्देह नहीं है

verses.sloka: कामं खलु सतां वृत्ते भ्राता ते भरतः स्थितः ।ज्येष्ठनुवर्ती धर्मात्मा सानुक्रोशो जितेन्द्रियः ॥२-४-२६॥
verses.transliteration: kāmaṁ khalu satāṁ vṛtte bhrātā te bharataḥ sthitaḥ ।jyeṣṭhanuvartī dharmātmā sānukrośo jitendriyaḥ ॥2-4-26॥

translations.english: It is true, your brother Bharata has adhered to the path of the virtuous and has followed his elder brother. No doubt, he is righteous, compassionate and self controlled.
translations.hindi: उस दुष्टात्मा ने भरत को तो तेरे माता-पिता के घर भेज दिया ओर बह ( अब ) निष्कण्टक राजसिंहासन .पर कल प्रातः काल श्रीरामचन्द्र का अभिषेक करना चाहता है

verses.sloka: किन्तु चित्तं मनुष्याणामनित्यमिति मे मतिः ।सतां च धर्मनित्यानां कृतशोभि च राघव ॥२-४-२७॥
verses.transliteration: kintu cittaṁ manuṣyāṇāmanityamiti me matiḥ ।satāṁ ca dharmanityānāṁ kṛtaśobhi ca rāghava ॥2-4-27॥

translations.english: Yet I think even the propitious minds of those who are virtuous and whose thoughts are fixed in righteousness can also become fickle.
translations.hindi: तूने पति के धोखे से अपने शत्रु को वैसे ही अपनी गोद में बिठा रखा है, जैसे कोई स्त्री (पुत्र के धोखे से सपं को गोद रख ले

verses.sloka: इत्युक्तः सोओऽभ्यनुज्ञातः श्वोभाविन्यभिषेचने ।व्रजेति रामः पितरमभिवाद्याभ्ययाद्गृहम् ॥२-४-२८॥
verses.transliteration: ityuktaḥ soo'bhyanujñātaḥ śvobhāvinyabhiṣecane ।vrajeti rāmaḥ pitaramabhivādyābhyayādgṛham ॥2-4-28॥

translations.english: Having spoken to Rama about the installation ceremony fixed for the next day, he (Dasaratha) permitted him to leave saying, 'You may go'. Rama paid obeisance to his father and returned to his abode.
translations.hindi: जिस प्रकार सपे वा शत्र. की उपेक्षा करने बाले पालनकत्ती के साथ सर्प शत्र चित व्यवहार करता है, उसो प्रकार का व्यबहार . आज दशरथ ने तेरे और तेरे पुत्र के साथ किया है

verses.sloka: प्रविश्य चात्मनो वेश्म राज्ञोद्धिष्टेऽभिषेचने ।तत्क्षणेन च निर्गम्य मातुर्न्तःपुरं ययौ ॥२-४-२९॥
verses.transliteration: praviśya cātmano veśma rājñoddhiṣṭe'bhiṣecane ।tatkṣaṇena ca nirgamya māturntaḥpuraṁ yayau ॥2-4-29॥

translations.english: With the installation fixed by the king, Rama went into his residence but left immediately to see his mother in her inner apartment.

verses.sloka: तत्र तां प्रवणामेव मातरं क्षौमवासिनीम् ।वाग्यतां देवतागारे ददर्शायाचतीं श्रियम् ॥२-४-३०॥
verses.transliteration: tatra tāṁ pravaṇāmeva mātaraṁ kṣaumavāsinīm ।vāgyatāṁ devatāgāre dadarśāyācatīṁ śriyam ॥2-4-30॥

translations.english: There he beheld his mother in silk apparel engrossed in silent prayer (to the gods) for his royal fortune in the room meant for the worship of the gods.
translations.hindi: है अजीब बुद्धि वाली ! ऐसी विपत्ति पूर्ण घटना को सुन कर भी उपेक्षा सी करने बाली ऐ कैकेयी ! देख अब भी समय है । अतएव जो कुछ तुझे अपनो भलाई के लिए करना हो सो तुरन्त कर डाल और अपने पुत्र को, अपने को और मुझे बचा

verses.sloka: प्रागेव चागता तत्र सुमित्रा लक्ष्मण स्तदा ।सीता चानायिता श्रुत्वा प्रियं रामाभिषेचनम् ॥२-४-३१॥
verses.transliteration: prāgeva cāgatā tatra sumitrā lakṣmaṇa stadā ।sītā cānāyitā śrutvā priyaṁ rāmābhiṣecanam ॥2-4-31॥

translations.english: Hearing the welcome tidings of the installation of her beloved Rama, Sita too, had been brought in. Sumitra and Lakshmana had already arrived there.

verses.sloka: तस्मिन् काले हि कौसल्या तस्थावामीलितेक्षणा ।सुमित्रयान्वास्यमाना सीतया लक्ष्मणेन च ॥२-४-३२॥
verses.transliteration: tasmin kāle hi kausalyā tasthāvāmīlitekṣaṇā ।sumitrayānvāsyamānā sītayā lakṣmaṇena ca ॥2-4-32॥

translations.english: At that moment Kausalya was meditating with her eyes halfclosed. Sumitra, Lakshmana and Sita were attending on her.

verses.sloka: श्रुत्वा पुष्येण पुत्रस्य यौवराज्याभिषेचनम् ।प्राणायामेन पुरुषं ध्यायमाना जनार्दनम् ॥२-४-३३॥
verses.transliteration: śrutvā puṣyeṇa putrasya yauvarājyābhiṣecanam ।prāṇāyāmena puruṣaṁ dhyāyamānā janārdanam ॥2-4-33॥

translations.english: Having heard that installation of her son as heirapparent was planned in Pushya constellation, Kausalya was meditating upon the Supreme Person, Lord Visnu by controlling her breath (Pranayama).
translations.hindi: आर अ्रत्यन्त . हर्षित. आर आश्चयेयुक्त हो, कैकेयी ने अपना एक बहुमूल्य उत्तम गहना, कुब्जा को दिया ॥ वर | 2; द्त्वा त्वाभरणं तस्ये कुब्जायै प्रमदोत्तमा । ` - कैकेयी मन्थरां दष्ट पुनरेवान्रवीदिदम्‌

verses.sloka: तथा सनियमामेव सोऽभिगम्याभिवाद्य च ।उवाच वचनं रामो हर्ष्यंस्तामिदं तदा ॥२-४-३४॥
verses.transliteration: tathā saniyamāmeva so'bhigamyābhivādya ca ।uvāca vacanaṁ rāmo harṣyaṁstāmidaṁ tadā ॥2-4-34॥

translations.english: While she (Kausalya) was in that state of meditation, Rama approached her, offered reverential salutation and said these words of praise enhancing her joy:

verses.sloka: अम्ब पित्रा नियुक्तोऽस्मि प्रजापालनकर्मणि ।भविता श्वोऽभिषेको मे यथा मि शासनं पितुः ॥२-४-३५॥
verses.transliteration: amba pitrā niyukto'smi prajāpālanakarmaṇi ।bhavitā śvo'bhiṣeko me yathā mi śāsanaṁ pituḥ ॥2-4-35॥

translations.english: "Whatever rites here are fitting for the consecration that is to take place tomorrow, have those auspicious rites performed today for me and for Vaidehi."
translations.hindi: मैं राम और भरत में कोई विशेष भेद नहीं देखती-अतः महाराज यदि श्रीरामचन्द्र को राज्य देते हैं, तो सुमे उनके इस कार्य से सन्तोष है

verses.sloka: सीतया प्युपवस्तव्या रजनीयं मया सह ।एवमृत्विगुपाध्यायैस्सह मामुक्तवान् पिता ॥२-४-३६॥
verses.transliteration: sītayā pyupavastavyā rajanīyaṁ mayā saha ।evamṛtvigupādhyāyaissaha māmuktavān pitā ॥2-4-36॥

translations.english: Hearing this, which she had longed for through so long a time, Kausalya, choked with tears of joy, spoke these words to Rama.
translations.hindi: अतएव ( इस पारितोषिक के अतिरिक्त ) और जो कुछ तू माँगे सो कह, अभी . तुमे में देती हुँ

verses.sloka: यानि यान्यत्र योग्यानि श्वो भाविन्यभिषेचने ।तानि मे मङ्गLआन्यद्य वैदेह्याश्चैव कारय ॥२-४-३७॥
verses.transliteration: yāni yānyatra yogyāni śvo bhāvinyabhiṣecane ।tāni me maṅgaLānyadya vaidehyāścaiva kāraya ॥2-4-37॥

translations.english: "Live long, dear child Rama. Your adversaries are destroyed. Endowed with royal fortune, gladden my kinsfolk and those of Sumitra."

verses.sloka: एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु कौसल्या चिरकालाभिकाङ्क्षितम् ।हर्ष्बाष्पकलं वाक्यमिदं राम मभाषत ॥२-४-३८॥
verses.transliteration: etacchrutvā tu kausalyā cirakālābhikāṅkṣitam ।harṣbāṣpakalaṁ vākyamidaṁ rāma mabhāṣata ॥2-4-38॥

translations.english: "Surely it was under an auspicious constellation that I bore you, dear son, since by your virtues you have won your father Dasaratha."

verses.sloka: वत्स राम चिरं जीव हतास्ते परिपन्थिनः ।ज्ञातीन्मे त्वं श्रियायुक्तः सुमित्रायाश्च नन्दय ॥२-४-३९॥
verses.transliteration: vatsa rāma ciraṁ jīva hatāste paripanthinaḥ ।jñātīnme tvaṁ śriyāyuktaḥ sumitrāyāśca nandaya ॥2-4-39॥

translations.english: "Surely my endurance in this lotus-eyed man was not in vain, my son, since this very royal fortune of the Ikshvakus shall now attend upon you."

verses.sloka: कल्याणे बत न्क्षत्रे मयि जातोऽसि पुत्रक ।येन त्वया दशरथो गुणैराराधितः पिता ॥२-४-४०॥
verses.transliteration: kalyāṇe bata nkṣatre mayi jāto'si putraka ।yena tvayā daśaratho guṇairārādhitaḥ pitā ॥2-4-40॥

translations.english: Addressed in this wise by his mother, Rama looked upon his brother, who sat bowing with joined palms, and said to him, smiling as it were:

verses.sloka: अमोघं बत मे क्षान्तं पुरुषे पुष्करेक्षणे ।येयमिक्ष्वाकुराज्यश्रीः पुत्र त्वां संश्रयिष्यति ॥२-४-४१॥
verses.transliteration: amoghaṁ bata me kṣāntaṁ puruṣe puṣkarekṣaṇe ।yeyamikṣvākurājyaśrīḥ putra tvāṁ saṁśrayiṣyati ॥2-4-41॥

translations.english: "Lakshmana, rule this earth along with me. This royal fortune has come to you, who are my second self."

verses.sloka: इत्येवमुक्तो मात्रेदं रामो भ्रातरमब्रवीत् ।प्राञ्जलिं प्रह्वमासीनमभिवीख्स्य स्मयन्निव ॥२-४-४२॥
verses.transliteration: ityevamukto mātredaṁ rāmo bhrātaramabravīt ।prāñjaliṁ prahvamāsīnamabhivīkhsya smayanniva ॥2-4-42॥

translations.english: "Enjoy, Saumitri, the enjoyments you desire and the fruits of the kingdom. It is for your sake that I desire my life and the kingdom too."

verses.sloka: लक्ष्मणेमां माया सार्धं प्रशाधि त्वं वसुन्धराम् ।द्वितीयं मेऽन्तरात्मानं त्वामियं श्रीरुपस्थिता ॥२-४-४३॥
verses.transliteration: lakṣmaṇemāṁ māyā sārdhaṁ praśādhi tvaṁ vasundharām ।dvitīyaṁ me'ntarātmānaṁ tvāmiyaṁ śrīrupasthitā ॥2-4-43॥

translations.english: Having spoken thus to Lakshmana, Rama saluted his mothers, took leave of Sita, and went to his own dwelling.

verses.sloka: सौमित्रे भुङ्क्ष्व भोगां स्त्वमिष्टान् राज्यफलानि च ।जीवितं च हि राज्यं च त्वदर्थमभिकामये ॥२-४-४४॥
verses.transliteration: saumitre bhuṅkṣva bhogāṁ stvamiṣṭān rājyaphalāni ca ।jīvitaṁ ca hi rājyaṁ ca tvadarthamabhikāmaye ॥2-4-44॥

verses.sloka: इत्युक्त्वा लक्ष्मणं रामो मातरावभिवाद्य च ।अभ्यनुज्ञाप्य सीतां च जगाम स्वं निवेश्नम् ॥२-४-४५॥
verses.transliteration: ityuktvā lakṣmaṇaṁ rāmo mātarāvabhivādya ca ।abhyanujñāpya sītāṁ ca jagāma svaṁ niveśnam ॥2-4-45॥
